notes: dc CALL 2026-08-03 Q2 2026 earnings call (AV transcript, provider-normalized; raw payload not saved to disk, only read in session)

dc CONCENTRATION 10-Q Note 2: no customer above 10% of total revenue in the three and six months ended 2026-06-30 and 2025; no named customer shares disclosed. Six months 2026: government 52%, commercial 48%; U.S. 80% of revenue. Top-20 average TTM revenue $124M (+67% from $75M).

dc SEGMENT CONTRIBUTION (not operating income, excludes SBC, R&D, G&A) Q2 2026: government 701.1M (71%), commercial 734.9M (78%), total 1,436.1M (74%); Q2 2025: government 63%, commercial 64%, total 64%; FY2025: government 66%, commercial 66% (10-K).

dc RPO 10-Q Note 3: 4.9B at 2026-06-30 (43% within 12 months, 36% months 13-36, remainder after); 4.1B at 2025-12-31 (38% / 36%). RPO excludes terminable-for-convenience and short-term contracts (most government), so total RDV 13.1B (+83% y/y, per call) is the broader measure; RDV and TCV presume all options exercised and no terminations.

dc COMMIT 10-Q Note 7: March 2026 cloud hosting amendment commits at least $5.6B over ten contract years to 2036-02-29, annual minimums $268M to $979M. No debt; $500M revolver undrawn (matures 2027-03-31). Cash, equivalents and short-term Treasuries $9.2B.

dc ONEOFF Q2 2026 other income net 91.8M includes unrealized gains on securities (call: SpaceX holdings = 0.03 USD GAAP EPS tailwind, 0.02 adjusted); six-month unrealized/realized securities gains 62.2M (cash flow statement). Interest income 77.5M. Adjusted EPS applies 23.0% long-term tax rate; GAAP tax 15.4M on 1,081M pretax (1.4%).

dc MGMT (management statements, not facts) raised FY2026 revenue guide midpoint to 8.154B, +82% y/y and +11 points vs prior guide; CEO says he is driving growth 'equal or above' the U.S. commercial rate for the next 18 months (aspiration, not guidance); expense ramps significantly in Q3 on seasonal hiring; adjusted gross margin 86% reflects cloud hosting taken on for one government customer; strategic commercial contracts revenue under 0.5M per remaining quarter.

dc MGMT call: U.S. commercial TCV 2.132B (+153% y/y, +81% q/q); trailing-12-month U.S. commercial TCV 5.964B (+117%); U.S. commercial customers 653 (+35% y/y, +6% q/q); NDR 157% (+700 bp q/q); total TCV on dollar-weighted duration basis +129% y/y; Dept of War TTM revenue under 25 bp of the Pentagon budget; Maven 25,000+ builders.
dc RISK 10-K Item 1A: revenue growth may not be sustained (growth is at record rates; Item 1A summary line 1).
dc RISK 10-K Item 1A: long, unpredictable sales cycle; large share of sales closes in last weeks of a quarter (summary line 2).
dc RISK 10-K Item 1A: limited number of customers account for a substantial portion of revenue; top-20 averages 124M TTM (summary line 3).
dc RISK 10-K Item 1A: may not realize full deal value; majority of contracts terminable for convenience, TCV/RDV assume options exercised (summary line 4).
dc RISK 10-K Item 1A: operating expenses will rise and profitability may not be maintained; Q3 seasonal expense ramp (summary line 5).
dc RISK 10-K Item 1A: quarterly results fluctuate; reliance on U.S. government budgets and U.S. share of revenue now 81%.

dc RISK 10-K Item 1A: intense competition (defense contractors, integrators, large software firms, frontier AI labs) and dependence on third-party cloud infrastructure and models; 5.6B cloud commitment to 2036.
dc RISK 10-K Item 1A: founders' concentrated voting power; SBC and dilution (diluted shares 2.569B vs basic 2.400B); AI-related regulatory and reputational scrutiny.

dc GAP quarter-results of 2026-11-03 (Q3) are after as_of; guidance above is the latest. Customer share of revenue by named customer not disclosed. Segment operating income not disclosed (contribution only). Raw transcript payload not saved verbatim.
